# Test Data

This directory contains test fixtures and sample YAML files for testing the amp-yaml-validator library.

## Directory Structure

- `valid/` - Valid amp.yaml samples that should pass validation
- `invalid/` - Invalid amp.yaml samples that should fail validation with specific errors
- `samples/` - Copies of real samples from the main samples directory

## Usage

Test files in this directory will be used in Phase 3 for extensive unit testing and integration testing of the validator library.

Each test file should be well-documented with comments explaining what validation rules it exercises.
